name: laya-system-one
description: Laya is a System One decision engine. A fast model that answers typed questions about text in one pass: pick a choice, give a score, or say yes, no or unsure, each with a calibrated probability. It serves the Jev-compatible /v1/systemone HTTP API for routing, triage, moderation and guardrails. Before first start: 1. Pick cpu or nvidia when you install. The nvidia choice sets Extra Parameters to --runtime=nvidia for you and needs the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin. 2. Optional: set an API key. Clients then send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Leave it blank for no key. 3. The first start downloads the model weights (a few GB) into the Model cache folder. The container shows healthy when the models are loaded. The API docs page is at http://YOUR_Unraid_IP:8012/docs. Keep the port on a trusted network.

paths.name: Model cache
paths.description: Downloaded model weights. The container sets the owner to PUID:PGID at start.

ports.name: API port
ports.description: Host port for the /v1/systemone API, /health and the /docs page.

variables.name: Models to load
variables.description: Models loaded at start. More models use more memory, about 2 GB for english or typed-decisions and 1.5 GB for multilingual. Pick english,multilingual if you send text in other languages. Non-English text still loads multilingual on first use.

variables.name: API key
variables.description: Optional. Blank means no key is needed. When set, clients send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. /health never needs a key.

variables.name: Load models at start
variables.description: 1 loads the models before the server listens, so the first request is fast. 0 loads each model on its first request.

variables.name: Auto typed decisions
variables.description: 1 lets the router send requests to the typed-decisions model on its own. 0 uses it only when a request names it.

variables.name: CPU threads
variables.description: Threads for CPU work. Keep at or below your physical core count.

variables.name: Max parallel requests
variables.description: Requests handled at once. Extra requests get HTTP 503 instead of waiting.

variables.name: Hugging Face token
variables.description: Optional. The default models are public and need no token.

variables.name: Offline mode
variables.description: 1 uses only models already in the Model cache and never downloads.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: One of critical, error, warning, info, debug or trace.

variables.name: NVIDIA GPU
variables.description: nvidia tag only. Use all or one GPU UUID from the NVIDIA Driver plugin page.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the server runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the server runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).
